title: UNC1069 WAVESHAPER.V2 -- T1195.002 axios npm supply chain C2 egress to sfrclak.com IOC
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin observed rules (derived from breach corpus)
description:
Campaign-bound sigma detection for the axios npm supply chain attack (Google Threat Intelligence Group, 2026-03-31 disclosure, 00:21-03:20 UTC). Attacker (UNC1069, North Korea-nexus, financially motivated, active since >=2018) injected a malicious dependency plain-crypto-js (v4.2.0/v4.2.1, published ~22 minutes before the malicious axios release) into axios releases v1.14.1 and v0.30.4 (100M+ / 83M+ weekly downloads). The dependency's postinstall hook runs an obfuscated dropper that deploys WAVESHAPER.V2 -- an updated variant of the WAVESHAPER backdoor previously attributed to UNC1069 -- across Windows/macOS/Linux. Detects outbound C2 communication to sfrclak.com or hardcoded C2 IP 142.11.206.73 port 8000.

Attribution basis (GTIG): backdoor variant match + infrastructure overlap with prior UNC1069 operations + VPN node connections.

Notable: initial access to the axios maintainer's publish rights was obtained via approximately two weeks of AI-generated / deepfake-enhanced social engineering (video calls, a fabricated collaborative-code-review pretext) -- not a technical exploit.

Cross-verified via 2 independent sources (Google Cloud GTIG blog, Tenable FAQ) before encoding; the source blog also reports exact file hashes and additional file-path artifacts, deliberately omitted here because this rule's second source did not independently corroborate them -- covers only the network indicators both sources agree on.

Aggregated from 1 active campaign disclosure 2026-03-31 (Google Threat Intelligence Group).
